summary: The FBI is still investigating a suspected break-in at its national crime database, and nobody has said how it happened. US stocks rebounded sharply today after a rough week, and real price data confirms it. No official source links the FBI and USDA cyber incidents.

events.title: FBI probes suspected breach of its national crime database
events.impact: Police use NCIC for warrant and missing-person checks. Reports do not say if it went down or if records were copied. The FBI declined to comment to the AP.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Reports rely on unnamed sources. No attacker named. No public evidence ties it to the September ShinyHunters jobs-portal breach.

events.title: USDA cyber incident hit farm payment and loan systems
events.impact: Farm loan software and a farmer-payment system had outages. A USDA official said most systems should be restored by Friday, with more work over the weekend. No newer full-restoration notice found.
events.stated_cause: A USDA under secretary called it a cyberthreat and said no personal data was lost. USDA has not named an attacker or given a detailed public account.

events.title: US stocks surge Monday after worst week in years
events.impact: Price check: S&P 500 closed up 4.73% at 7,237 and Nasdaq up 6.51%, best day since April 2025. Friday the S&P fell 3.7% and the VIX closed near 36. No trading halts found.
events.stated_cause: Reports tie the rebound to Nvidia bringing back Jensen Huang as CEO. The earlier drop was tied to AI worries. No technical fault or cyber attack reported.

events.title: Bitcoin steady near 61K USD, down about 5% on the week
events.impact: Price check: CoinGecko 61,548; OKX 61,245; Bitget 61,242; Yahoo 61,260. Sources agree within 1%. Up 1-4% in 24h, down about 5-7% over 7 days. One site showed 63,443, an outlier. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Moves track the stock selloff and rebound and Fed worries.

events.title: Tanker attacks near Strait of Hormuz at highest level of the war
events.impact: Three more tankers were hit Friday and Saturday, with fires and no deaths reported. Bahrain says Iran hit a civilian industrial site. A Jordanian sailor from an earlier attack is still missing.
events.stated_cause: Nobody has claimed the projectile hits. A maritime risk firm says Iranian involvement is likely. Iran says tankers hit mines; that is unconfirmed.

events.title: Delta computer outage delayed flights; crews used manual math
events.impact: About 1,654 of 5,000 Delta flights were delayed Sunday, per the New York Times. Crews used manual workarounds while automation was restored. FAA feed shows only a San Diego volume delay now.
events.stated_cause: Delta blamed its weight and balance system. The FAA said the delays were not related to air traffic control systems. No official source reports a cyber attack.

events.title: Shopify checkout reportedly down for some users
events.impact: User reports rose around 12:41 p.m. ET. A forum post says Shopify's status page confirmed a major checkout outage. Size and length of impact are unknown. I found no wire report.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows degraded performance
events.impact: Cloudflare's status feed lists Sites and Services as degraded and Amsterdam under maintenance. No wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

events.title: CISA adds four actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Covers SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway, VMware vCenter and Apache Roller. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA cites active exploitation. It names no attacker and does not tie the flaws to the USDA or FBI incidents.

connection_assessment.reasoning: The FBI and USDA incidents are both reported as hacks, but nobody has said how they happened or who did it, and no official source links them. Delta blamed its own weight and balance system. The stock jump has a stated business cause, and Hormuz attacks are a separate war story.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement naming the same attacker or company behind the FBI and USDA incidents, or several big systems failing at the same moment, would make me think they are connected.

alert.reason: No new confirmed event shows a link or a widespread failure; the main items are being investigated or have cleared.

prep_note: No action is needed for most people. If you are a farmer, call your local FSA office to log program choices before the Dec 11 deadline. If you travel this week, check your airline app before leaving. Keep some cash on hand, as you normally would. Use official FBI, USDA and CISA pages for updates.
